name: Secret Office: Daepyonim-ui Bam-eun Biseoui Geos
original_name: 시크릿 오피스 : 대표님의 밤은 비서의 것
source:
The protagonist is a new employee taking their first steps into the professional world.
From the very beginning, every task assigned is demanding, and standing beside them is a cold, flawless direct supervisor who allows no mistakes.

She is strict and uncompromising when it comes to work. Then one day, the protagonist is summoned to her private office, where she makes an unexpected request that goes beyond the boundaries of work.

Inside a closed office, where only the two of them remain, the clear line between superior and subordinate begins to blur.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4354050/]Steam[/url]]
